name: Congestion Desk
tagline: Predicts oil price moves from live tanker traffic and port congestion and trades on it.
problem: Physical shipping signals reach markets late.
solution: Tracks tankers into major US ports from ship-position data, measures congestion, and uses gradient-boosted models to predict prices and log trades, with emissions summaries.
demo_moment: Team-described: a port congestion map with live predictions.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Uses physical-world data as a market signal.

lessons: Alternative data makes a markets pitch stand out.
